pp_seo_desc: Privacy policy of the Chrome extension Auto Like Assistant (足あとメーカー): what it stores on your device, what it never sends, the permissions it uses and how the contact form works.
pp_translation_note: This is a translation of the Japanese original. If they differ, the Japanese version prevails.
pp_intro: This privacy policy explains how user information is handled in the Chrome extension “Auto Like Assistant” (足あとメーカー, the “Extension”) provided by the developer Ramune (the “Developer”).
pp_collect: To provide its features, the Extension may obtain and use the following information.
pp_page_h: (1) Information on the page you are viewing
pp_page_li1: DOM elements on the supported websites (links to profiles, Like buttons, etc.)
pp_page_li2: The URL of the current page
pp_page_p: This information is used on the spot only to run the automatic visit and auto-like features, and is never sent anywhere.
pp_local_li1: Settings you choose (people per reload, maximum visits, delay in seconds, whether auto-like is on, etc.)
pp_local_li2: The history of visited profiles (profile URL or ID), and running totals of visits and stops
pp_local_li3: Operating records (install date, review prompt status, control panel position, and a record of failure types and times — latest 50)
pp_local_li4: The IDs of tabs opened for visits (only during the browser session)
pp_local_p: This information is stored only on your device, using Chrome's Storage API (chrome.storage.sync, chrome.storage.local and chrome.storage.session).
pp_local_sync: Settings are kept in chrome.storage.sync, so if Chrome sync is turned on they may be synced through your Google account to Chrome on your other devices. The Developer never receives them.
pp_local_none: * The Extension does not obtain or store information that directly identifies a person, such as names, email addresses, phone numbers, addresses, or the contents of other members' profiles (photos, names, bios).
pp_purpose: The information is used only for the following purposes.
pp_purpose_li1: Providing automatic profile visits and auto-likes
pp_purpose_li2: Avoiding duplicate visits to the same profiles
pp_purpose_li4: Investigating problems (only when you submit the contact form or the survey)
pp_send_p: The Extension never automatically sends the information it handles to the Developer's or any third party's servers.
pp_send_form: When you open the contact form from a link in the Extension, or when the survey page opens after uninstalling, anonymous diagnostic values are added to the page URL (Extension version, days since install, total visits, number of stops, counts and timing of failure types, and, for the contact form, the app in use). They do not identify you, and they reach the Developer by email — together with what you entered — only if you submit the form, via the Developer's form server (Cloudflare Workers).
pp_third: The information is never provided to third parties except in the following cases.
pp_third_li2: When you have given explicit consent
pp_access: To provide automatic visits and auto-likes, the Extension accesses the content of pages on the supported websites. Visits and likes are made on each service you are signed in to, as your own account. Page content is not used for any purpose other than providing the Extension's features, and is never saved or accumulated.
pp_perm: The Extension uses the following Chrome permissions.
pp_perm_storage: Saving settings, visit history and the IDs of tabs opened for visits
pp_perm_tabs: Reading information about visit tabs and opening and closing them (on with, profiles are opened in a new tab and then closed)
pp_perm_hosts: Running on the HTTPS sites and subdomains of Pairs (pairs.lv), with (with.is), Tokyo Calendar Date (tokyo-calendar-date.jp), Tinder (tinder.com), Badoo (badoo.com), OkCupid (okcupid.com) and Match (match.com)
pp_perm_note: These are the minimum permissions needed for the Extension to work.
pp_store: All data the Extension saves stays on your device (in Chrome's storage). The Developer does not collect or store your data. You can delete the visit history and progress with the reset button (↺) in the control panel, and all saved data by uninstalling the Extension.
pp_site: This page and the introduction pages use Google Analytics (with cookies) to understand how they are visited. The introduction pages also use Google Ads conversion tracking to measure advertising. The collected data is handled under Google's privacy policy. The Extension itself does not use these.
pp_contact: For questions about this policy, please use the contact form or the email address below.
pp_change: This policy may be revised as needed in response to changes in law or in the service. Any revised policy will be published on this page promptly.
